surname.definition: n. the name used to identify the members of a family (as distinguished from each member's given name)
surname.translation:
n. 姓, 别号, 绰号
vt. 呼以姓氏, 起绰号

surnamed.translation: vt. 给…加姓（surname的过去式与过去分词形式）

surnames.definition: n. the name used to identify the members of a family (as distinguished from each member's given name)
surnames.translation: n. 姓( surname的复数形式 )

surnaming.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Surname
surnaming.translation: vt. 给…加姓（surname的现在分词形式）

surnominal.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a surname or surnames.
